info.name: Reonic REST Api v3 Activities Appointments API

params.name: calendarIds
params.description: Comma-separated list or repeated query param of calendar IDs to fetch appointments for.

params.name: residentialProjectId
params.description: Return only appointments linked to the given residential project. Mutually exclusive with `commercialProjectId`. Reference to [**Residential Projects**](#tag/residential-projects)

params.name: commercialProjectId
params.description: Return only appointments linked to the given commercial project. Mutually exclusive with `residentialProjectId`. Reference to [**Commercial Projects**](#tag/commercial-projects)

params.name: start.gt
params.description: Filter records where start is after this datetime (exclusive)

params.name: start.lt
params.description: Defaults to the day one year from now.

params.name: end.gt
params.description: Defaults to now, so that by default only upcoming appointments are returned.

params.name: end.lt
params.description: Filter records where end is before this datetime (exclusive)

params.name: itemsPerPage
params.description: Number of items per page. Default: 50. Max: 200.

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort order. Use field names for ascending (e.g. "createdAt"), minus sign for descending (e.g. "-createdAt"). Chain with commas (e.g. "createdAt,editedAt"). Sortable fields: start, end. Defaults to start.

items.docs:
Lists appointments on Reonic calendars in a paginated format.

**Allowed API keys:** Read-only, Read and Write

Create an appointment on a Reonic calendar.

**Allowed API keys:** Read and Write

Update fields of an appointment on a Reonic calendar. Omit fields to leave them untouched, send `null` to clear them (where possible) or send a value to replace it.

**Allowed API keys:** Read and Write

Delete an appointment on a Reonic calendar.

**Allowed API keys:** Read and Write
